definitions.explanation: The late night hours, typically from around midnight to early morning when most people are asleep.

examples.japanese: {夜中|よなか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: I woke up in the middle of the night.

examples.japanese: {夜中|よなか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}りました→鳴る：01143_naru⟧。
examples.english: The phone rang in the middle of the night.

examples.japanese: {夜中|よなか}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}しました→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
examples.english: I studied until the middle of the night.

examples.japanese: {夜中|よなか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦びっくり→びっくり：03003_bikkuri⟧⟦しました→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was startled by a loud noise outside in the middle of the night.

examples.japanese: {夜中|よなか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{二時|にじ}⟦ごろ→頃：00932_goro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{泣|な}き→泣く：00655_naku⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{起|お}きて→起きる：00521_okiru⟧⟦ミルク→ミルク：00284_miruku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦あげました→あげる：00546_ageru⟧。
examples.english: The baby started crying around 2 AM, so the mother got up and gave milk.

notes:
{夜中|よなか} refers to the deep night hours when most people are sleeping, roughly midnight to early morning. It is later and more specific than ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧ (night/evening).

COMMON PARTICLES:
- {夜中|よなか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in the middle of the night (point in time)
- {夜中|よなか}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: until the middle of the night
- {夜中|よなか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧⟦{時|じ}→〜時：09869_ji⟧: 2 AM (specific time within {夜中|よなか})

RELATED TIME WORDS:
- ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧: night, evening (broader, from sunset onward)
- ⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧: late at night (more formal, often used in media)
- ⟦{未明|みめい}→未明：27573_mimei⟧: predawn, early morning hours
- ⟦{真夜中|まよなか}→真夜中：05425_mayonaka⟧: dead of night (emphasizes the very middle)

USAGE NOTE:
{夜中|よなか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ suggests the call was inconveniently late.
